sentence: I have already finished the work you gave me
meaning: 你交给我的工作我已经完成了
rule: 现在完成时与定语从句

sentence: Unless you hurry you will miss the last bus
meaning: 除非快一点，否则你会错过末班车
rule: unless 引导条件状语从句

sentence: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin
meaning: 坐在窗边的女孩是我的表妹

sentence: What matters most is how we solve the problem
meaning: 最重要的是我们如何解决问题

sentence: He apologized for keeping us waiting so long
meaning: 他为让我们久等而道歉

sentence: The road was so narrow that two cars could not pass
meaning: 道路太窄，两辆车无法同时通过

sentence: It took her two hours to complete the report
meaning: 她花了两个小时完成报告
rule: It takes sb time to do

sentence: The museum is worth visiting more than once
meaning: 这座博物馆值得多次参观

sentence: We were asked to hand in the forms before Friday
meaning: 我们被要求在周五前交表格
rule: 被动语态与 ask sb to do

sentence: The harder the task becomes the calmer she gets
meaning: 任务越难，她反而越冷静

sentence: I did not realize the truth until he explained it
meaning: 直到他解释我才明白真相

sentence: There is no point in worrying about what has happened
meaning: 为已经发生的事担心没有意义
rule: There is no point in doing

sentence: She speaks English as confidently as her teacher
meaning: 她说英语和老师一样自信

sentence: Neither answer seems completely correct to me
meaning: 两个答案在我看来都不完全正确

sentence: The letter should have been sent yesterday
meaning: 这封信昨天就应该寄出
rule: 情态动词完成式的被动语态

sentence: Having checked the door he went downstairs
meaning: 检查门锁后，他下了楼
rule: 现在分词完成式作状语

sentence: I prefer reading at home to studying in a noisy cafe
meaning: 比起在嘈杂咖啡馆学习，我更喜欢在家阅读
rule: prefer doing A to doing B

sentence: The reason why he left early remains unclear
meaning: 他提前离开的原因仍不清楚

sentence: No sooner had we arrived than it began to rain
meaning: 我们刚到就开始下雨
rule: no sooner 置前引起倒装

sentence: You are supposed to keep your phone silent here
meaning: 你在这里应该把手机调成静音

sentence: The plan needs discussing before we make a decision
meaning: 作决定前，这个计划需要讨论

sentence: She had her bicycle repaired near the station
meaning: 她在车站附近找人修了自行车

sentence: Even though the answer was wrong his method was useful
meaning: 尽管答案错了，他的方法仍有用
rule: even though 引导让步状语从句

sentence: Hardly had the bell rung when the students rushed out
meaning: 铃声刚响，学生们就冲了出去

sentence: The teacher suggested that we review the lesson again
meaning: 老师建议我们再复习一次课文

sentence: Anyone who finishes early may check the answers
meaning: 提前完成的人可以检查答案

sentence: The project turned out to be easier than expected
meaning: 这个项目结果比预想的容易

sentence: Only by practicing regularly can you improve steadily
meaning: 只有规律练习才能稳定进步
rule: only 置前引起部分倒装

sentence: She found it difficult to concentrate in the crowded room
meaning: 她发现在拥挤房间里很难集中注意力

sentence: Whether we leave today depends on the weather
meaning: 我们今天是否出发取决于天气

sentence: The more carefully you read the fewer mistakes you make
meaning: 读得越仔细，犯错越少

sentence: He is used to getting up before sunrise
meaning: 他习惯在日出前起床

sentence: Not all useful lessons are learned in a classroom
meaning: 并非所有有用的经验都在课堂里学到

sentence: The old bridge is believed to be over three hundred years old
meaning: 人们认为这座古桥已有三百多年历史
rule: 主语 + be believed to do

sentence: If I had known the truth I would have acted differently
meaning: 如果早知道真相，我会采取不同做法
rule: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气

sentence: There used to be a small bookstore on this corner
meaning: 这个街角过去有一家小书店

sentence: In spite of the heavy fog the flight landed safely on time
meaning: 尽管大雾弥漫，航班仍安全准点降落
rule: in spite of 让步介词短语

sentence: The professor whose lecture we attended yesterday is from Oxford
meaning: 我们昨天去听讲座的那位教授来自牛津

sentence: It was not until midnight that the storm finally stopped
meaning: 直到午夜，暴风雨才终于停止
rule: It was not until ... that 强调句

sentence: Had you followed my advice you would have avoided the trouble
meaning: 如果你早听我的建议，就能避免这个麻烦
rule: 虚拟语气省略 if 倒装

sentence: The experiment proved far more challenging than they had imagined
meaning: 这项实验证明远比他们想象的更具挑战性

sentence: Under no circumstances should you share your personal password
meaning: 在任何情况下你都不应透露个人密码
rule: 否定介词短语置前完全倒装

sentence: What surprised us was that she mastered the skill in two days
meaning: 让我们惊讶的是她只用两天就掌握了这门技能
rule: 主语从句与表语从句并用

sentence: He devoted all his spare time to helping disadvantaged children
meaning: 他把所有业余时间都奉献给帮助弱势儿童

sentence: The new policy is intended to protect the ecological environment
meaning: 这项新政策旨在保护生态自然环境

sentence: No matter how difficult the situation is we must keep going
meaning: 无论处境多么艰难，我们都必须坚持前行
rule: no matter how 引导让步状语从句

sentence: So fast did the news spread that everyone knew it by noon
meaning: 消息传播得如此之快，以至于中午人尽皆知

sentence: It is essential that every student be fully prepared for the exam
meaning: 每个学生都必须为考试做好充分准备
